title: RiskON Orchestra
tagline: Many agents investigate. Evidence decides. Humans approve.
subcopy: A local-first suitability assistant that answers with evidence, clarifies missing context, abstains safely, routes to the right support function, and evolves only through governed approval.

architecture.description: Receives a question and any explicitly supplied structured context.
Keeps event-day source intake local, inspectable, and separate from the runtime.
Normalises the query and identifies required context and retrieval channels.
Combines deterministic retrieval signals while retaining local provenance.
Checks the facts that determine whether evidence applies.
Activates only the bounded workers justified by the assessed risk.
Allows only explicitly supported, scope-valid claims through the gate.
Returns the safe decision permitted by the evidence contract.
Routes abstentions to a functional support queue without inventing a person.
Adds approved knowledge only after Policy CI and independent human approval.

footer: No real client or Bank data is included.
